killedBy: Apply and Reload hands the page exactly the URL it was previewing
why: Rebuilding the URL at press time rather than handing over the one on screen. It drops the page's own non-developer query -- the base is not in this call -- so a deep link or a router's parameters vanish on Apply while the preview above the button said they would survive. Written with `devMenuView` rather than `devSearchFrom`, which hud.ts does not import: a mutation that fails to COMPILE is killed by the type checker and says nothing about whether the behaviour is guarded -- the trap issue #652 recorded when a brace-unbalanced replacement killed 13 tests instead of 2.
